request: Track physical holds where supported; when unavailable, use Caps Lock enabled/disabled status as the fallback.

behavior.macOS: Caps Lock follows getModifierState on scoped keyboard events, including ordinary typing. No hold-duration timer.
behavior.otherPlatforms: Physical keydown/keyup tracking, including Caps Lock; no lock-state latch.
behavior.cleanup: Blur, focus outside the application, hidden document and disposal clear caps. The next in-scope keyboard event resynchronizes Mac lock status.
behavior.scope: Keyboard/form behavior only; no submission, scene geometry, assets, camera or held optimization candidate changes.

verification.unitAndModel: Event-sequence tests simulate 30 seconds, Mac down/on-up/off and down-only toggles, preexisting status, independent keys, Meta cleanup, scope and disposal. Integration with the actual Three.js keyboard checks cap height, stable held geometry and release.

warnings: Vinext cannot statically classify the case-studies route

browserSmoke.viewport: Default browser viewport; no override or image scaling; drawing-buffer/DPR not recorded for this input smoke check.
observed: Name field accepts ordinary typing after a virtual Caps Lock keypress
Keyboard and form remain visually unobstructed
browserSmoke.limitation: Virtual keypresses do not reproduce physical macOS Caps Lock flagsChanged events. Screenshot is a layout/typing smoke check, not proof of physical hold or status tracking.

verification.testAuthoring: A generic synthetic test event initially lacked getModifierState; the fixture now supplies modifier state explicitly and pins its platform. This was test-fixture setup, not an observed browser defect.

performance: Removed the Mac pulse timer. Existing event-driven animation settles while held; no new polling, geometry, textures or assets. No frame-time, memory, heat or battery improvement measured or claimed.
limitations: Native Safari and physical Mac keyboard input were not automated or captured.
No browser capability API exposes whether physical Caps Lock release is available; the fallback targets the known macOS event limitation.
Caps Lock status becomes available from a keyboard event; focus alone cannot reveal the current OS lock state.

independentCritic.summary: Physical holds preserved; approved Mac Caps Lock status fallback replaces the premature pulse. Independent releases, simultaneous holds, preexisting lock status, Command cleanup, scope and disposal are covered. Current documentation supersedes the old workaround.
independentCritic.evidence: Reviewed actual source, regression tests, documentation, manifest, logs and screenshot; source hashes match. Screenshot supports ordinary typing/layout only.
limitations: No native Safari or physical Mac keyboard verification.
Platform matching selects the fallback rather than detecting physical-event capability.
Cleared lock status returns on the next in-app keyboard event.
